title: Upcoming Demo 2.2 for my AI-assisted post-apocalyptic turn-based RPG
author: No_Piano_1857
selftext:
I’m currently working on the next update (Demo 2.2) for my small post-apocalyptic turn-based RPG, Arkansas 2125.

The project uses AI as part of the workflow — mainly for coding support, visual iteration, and UI elements — while core gameplay systems are built manually.

This update continues refining visuals, clarity, and overall atmosphere based on recent feedback. I’m also making some smaller adjustments, like renaming the “Oasis Generator” to “Farm Restorer” to better fit the world and its logic.

More details coming soon — just wanted to share a quick progress update.

replies.author: No_Piano_1857
replies.body: The scenes in the background menu are generated in chatgpt. Why chatgpt? Because his work worked best for my game, and naturally. In Gemini I couldn't get the same effect as in the chat, gpt kept creating ugly, unnatural-looking graphics. I have already made the UI buttons myself in Affinity Photo

comments.author: Poietilinx
comments.body:
Constructive critique here!  
Your game would have a lot to benefit from if you made the color pallet a bit more strict, (specially in the ui). There are websites like colourlovers and lospec that you can go around and shop for chromatic pallet ideas to put on your game.  
I am doing a similarish project, but its 2.5d rather than isometric, let me show you how my ss look like to give you some inspiration.
